forbiddenImageImport.text: Importing from 'next/image' is not allowed. Use '@structure/source/components/images/Image' instead, so an image renders the same way whichever framework is underneath it.

forbiddenLinkImport.text: Importing from 'next/link' is not allowed. Use '@structure/source/components/navigation/Link' instead, so a link renders the same way whichever framework is underneath it.

forbiddenMotionImport.text: Importing from 'framer-motion' is not allowed. Use 'motion/react', which is the same library under the name it ships as now.

forbiddenNavigationImport.text: Importing from 'next/navigation' is not allowed. Use '@structure/source/router/Navigation', which is the same navigation without binding the file to one framework's router.
